false_negatives.finding: Future claim boundaries are checked only by reading nine known keys. A final hammer with an additional launch_authorized=true key remains fully sealed, exact-SHA matched and accepted.
Future review and release JSON uses ordinary json.loads. A double status key with a forged first value and admitted last value is accepted rather than rejected as ambiguous authority.
The runner source checker does not structurally parse the success candidate receipt. Removing runner_sha256 from that receipt remains source-admitted after the contract pins the mutant runner SHA.
The same success receipt may omit source_contract_sha256 without source-check failure.
The same success receipt may omit launch_release_sha256 without source-check failure.
source_hammer_manifest_sha256 may be removed from the success receipt and replaced by a comment token elsewhere. The checker uses raw runner.count rather than active receipt structure.
final_hammer_outer_file_sha256 has the same comment-residue bypass, so the sealed success package need not reconstruct all three final-hammer seal layers.

minimum_additive_successor: Use duplicate-key-rejecting strict JSON and exact-object schemas for source hammer, launch release and final hammer. Require the claim_boundary key set to equal the nine frozen false claims exactly.
Replace raw token counts with a comment-stripped structural parser or exact-normalized source sections for RUN_FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE.txt, attempt.txt and m1344_receipt.json.

For each of failure, attempt and success receipts, require exactly the same nine identity fields: runner, source contract, source hammer review/manifest/outer, launch release, and final hammer review/manifest/outer; require each live value expression exactly once.
Add at least 27 receipt mutations (nine fields times three receipt paths), including comment-residue variants for source/final three-layer seals.

Retain the working two-mode, missing/mismatch/symlink, cardinality, namespace, no-retry, two-by-five and claim-false gates, then obtain another fresh different-author blind hammer with zero false negatives.
